title: How a Godly Man Makes Room for a Brother Before He's Asked
caption:
"I'm good" said twice in a row isn't information. It's a door half shut.

A godly man doesn't wait for the hospital call to show up for a brother. He shows up on the Tuesday that looks fine from the outside, with a reason that isn't the real reason, so it doesn't feel weird to ask.

Who in your life hasn't been asked in a while? Ask him today.
